name: tuffex-ai-stream-markdown
title: TxStreamMarkdown 流式 Markdown 渲染（块级增量 + 代码高亮 + mermaid）
creator: TalexDreamSoul

meta.nextAction: Only the visual criteria are left: light and dark themes plus reduced-motion, and the zoom overlay behaviour by eye. The streaming, mermaid, code-block and sanitiser criteria all have tests.
meta.blocker: A running app for the theme and reduced-motion pass. Nothing else.
meta.evidence: Measured 2026-08-11: ai-elements plus stream-markdown, 58 passed / 6 files. Coverage maps to the criteria directly. Block identity: "keeps settled block DOM nodes across streaming updates", "reuses settled block objects and only assigns fresh ids to new blocks", "keeps the tail id stable while a paragraph grows". Cursor: "marks a paragraph tail for the inline cursor while streaming". Mermaid: skeleton with draft source while open, diagram once the fence closes under strict security, fallback to source with an alert when rendering fails. Sanitiser: nothing rendered before it resolves, sanitised markup once ready, unsanitised only when the flag is off. Code block: highlight after close, bare fences labelled text without asking shiki, stale highlights ignored.
